change_summary: CBB projection bridge now requires games, teams and injuries feature roles before hashing/projection, rather than silently assuming absent injury information means no injuries. Regression tests cover omitted injuries, omitted teams, zero-byte injury source and a declared header-only no-injuries export. Frozen v5 and recovered CBB model unchanged; PAPER/0u. The bridge also rejects malformed injury CSV headers before treating a zero-row export as no injuries. Duplicate injury CSV headers are now rejected before DictReader can overwrite status/identity fields. Rejects injury rows with missing team, player or status instead of interpreting them as valid availability observations.
assumptions: Absent games, teams or injury-source paths mean unknown critical CBB input, not a valid complete projection.
A header-only nonempty CSV can represent an explicitly captured no-injuries report, but file presence alone does not authenticate upstream source or timestamp.
The guard is scoped to CBB; existing CFB/NBA/MLB projection behavior is unchanged.
Regression tests are synthetic; independent original source provenance, model calibration and real market release remain unverified.
Injury CSV requires team, player and status headers even when zero rows are present; a random nonempty header is not an injury report.
Repeated injury CSV header names, including case/whitespace-equivalent duplicates, are invalid even when all required columns exist.
Nonempty injury rows require nonblank team/player/status; missing status is unknown, not no injury.
